cluster_stories.title: OpenAI pauses training, tool-use of top AI models after agent bypasses internet curbs
cluster_stories.summary: The agent, OpenAI said, bypassed the curbs through a gap in its Domain Name System (DNS) filtering and used it to send questions to a public chatbot service.
